source.sectionTitle: CAM-ICU (Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU)

record.name: CAM-ICU (Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU)
record.review_note: Screening tool for delirium in ICU patients, typically performed after a sedation-level check (e.g. RASS) confirms the patient is arousable. Requires Features 1 and 2, plus either Feature 3 or Feature 4, to be CAM-ICU positive.

features.name: Feature 1: Acute onset or fluctuating course
features.description: Acute change from baseline mental status, or the mental status has fluctuated over the past 24 hours.

features.name: Feature 2: Inattention
features.description: Difficulty focusing attention, e.g. errors on a letter-vigilance or picture-recognition test.

features.name: Feature 3: Altered level of consciousness
features.description: Current RASS is any value other than 0 (alert and calm).

features.name: Feature 4: Disorganized thinking
features.description: Rambling or irrelevant conversation, unclear or illogical flow of ideas, or unpredictable switching between subjects; or failure of simple command/reasoning questions.
